result: I found 16 issues, listed most severe first. Nothing was run and no file was changed; every finding comes from reading the code. ## High **1. Cut deletes elements even when copy fails** - Location: `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionClipboard.tsx:117-120`, `packages/excalidraw/actions/manager.tsx:141-146` - Cause: `actionCut` calls async `actionCopy.perform` without `await` and discards its result, including `errorMessage`. It then deletes the selection unconditionally. - Cause, keyboard path: `keyTest` matches Ctrl+X on keydown and runs `perform` with `event = null`. The keydown `preventDefault()` most likely suppresses the native `cut` event (browser behaviour, not tested here). The copy then goes through `navigator.clipboard.writeText`. - Effect: a failed write still deletes the elements and shows no error. That path also writes `text/plain` only, with no custom MIME type. - Fix: make `perform` async and `await` the copy. Skip the delete and surface `errorMessage` when the copy fails. Drop `keyTest` so the `cut` event is handled by `onCut`, the same way copy works. **2. Pasted `files` from clipboard JSON are never validated** - Location: `packages/excalidraw/clipboard.ts:539-551`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx:4918` and `:5326-5342`, `packages/element/src/image.ts:30` - Cause: `parseClipboard` accepts any `text/plain` JSON with a matching `type`. Elements go through `restoreElements`, but `files` go into `this.files` unchecked. `dataURL` is assigned directly to `image.src`. - Effect: a payload with `dataURL: "https://host/x.png"` makes the browser request that URL on paste. The canvas then becomes tainted, so `toBlob` throws and PNG export and copy-as-PNG break for the scene. - Effect: `files: [null]` throws at `fileData.id`, and `files: "abc"` adds junk entries. - Fix: validate each file entry. Require `dataURL` to start with `data:`, require an allowed `mimeType`, and require a string `id` that matches the key. Drop invalid entries. ## Medium **3. Mixed-content paste loses the text when image fetch fails** - Location: `App.tsx:4977-5008`, `clipboard.ts:532-536` - Cause: if the HTML has any ``, only images are pasted. `parseClipboard` returns `{ mixedContent }` only, so `text/plain` is dropped. Cross-origin `fetch` often fails on CORS. - Effect: `insertImages([])` runs with an empty list and the user gets an error dialog. The copied text is gone. - Fix: when no image resolves, fall back to the text nodes. Keep `text` next to `mixedContent` in `ClipboardData`. **4. Paste pipeline has no error boundary** - Location: `App.tsx:4760-4815`, `:4687`, `:4825`; `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts:970`; `packages/element/src/transform.ts:585` - Cause: `insertClipboardContent` is not wrapped in try/catch. - `elements: [null]` throws in `restoreElements` (`element.type`) and in `convertToExcalidrawElements` (`element.id`). - `await import("@excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw")` sits outside its `try`, so a chunk load failure skips the text fallback. - A throw in `addMissingFiles` lands after `replaceAllElements` but before `scheduleCapture`, so elements are inserted with no undo entry. - Effect: unhandled promise rejection and a silent paste failure. - Fix: wrap the pipeline in try/catch and set `errorMessage`. Move the `import()` inside the `try`. Filter out non-object elements before restore. Call `addMissingFiles` before mutating the scene. **5. `readSystemClipboard` fallback logic is wrong** - Location: `clipboard.ts:262-295` - Cause: the `DataError` ("clipboard probably empty") check is on the inner `readText` error, and only when `navigator.clipboard.read` is missing. The outer `read()` `DataError` is never checked. - Effect: on an empty clipboard `readText()` returns `""`, the original error is rethrown, and the user sees the `asyncPasteFailedOnRead` dialog. - Cause: if `navigator.clipboard` is undefined (insecure context), `clipboardItems` is `undefined` and `for...of` at line 295 throws `TypeError`. - Cause: both warn messages name the fallback direction backwards. - Fix: check `error.name === "DataError"` on the outer error first and return `{}`. Return `{}` on empty `readText`. Guard a missing `navigator.clipboard`. Correct the messages. **6. The `copyText` try/catch can never catch anything** - Location: `actionClipboard.tsx:264-268` - Cause: `copyTextToSystemClipboard` is async and not awaited, so the `catch` is unreachable. - Effect: a failed write becomes an unhandled rejection and no error is shown. - Fix: make `perform` async, `await` the call, and return `errorMessage` on failure. **7. Copy as SVG loses user activation in Safari** - Location: `packages/excalidraw/data/index.ts:156-158` - Cause: the clipboard write happens after `await svgPromise`. Safari requires the write in the same tick as the gesture (see the comment at `clipboard.ts:559-562`). The PNG path handles this and the SVG path does not. I did not test this in Safari. - Fix: use `navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ "text/plain": svgPromise.then(toBlob) })])`, with the current path as fallback. **8. Paste is silently dropped based on the last pointer position** - Location: `App.tsx:4776-4786`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.viewport.ts:438` - Cause: the gate is `elementFromPoint(lastPosition) instanceof HTMLCanvasElement`. `lastPosition` starts at `(0, 0)` and only updates on document `pointermove`. - Effect: paste before the first mouse move, or after a last touch on the UI, is ignored with no feedback. - Effect: context-menu paste goes through the same gate. The position is that of the "Paste" menu item, not the right-click point, and a menu item overlapping a toolbar blocks the paste. - Fix: skip the gate for synthetic events from `actionPaste`. Fall back to `"center"` when the position is unset or not over the canvas. Store the context-menu open position and use it. ## Low **9. The execCommand fallback steals focus** - Location: `clipboard.ts:640-680` - Cause: the textarea is appended to the global `document.body` and `select()` moves focus out of the editor container. Focus is never restored. - Effect: `isExcalidrawActive` becomes false, so later copy and paste are ignored until the user clicks the canvas. The code also targets the wrong document when the editor lives in a popup or iframe. - Fix: save and restore `activeElement`. Use the owner document. **10. Late `preventDefault()` and an unconditional tool reset** - Location: `App.tsx:4809-4813` - Cause: `event.preventDefault()` runs after awaits, so it does nothing. `setActiveTool` runs even when nothing was pasted. - Effect: an empty or failed paste still resets the active tool. - Fix: call `preventDefault()` synchronously, after the gates. Reset the tool only after a successful insert. **11. Frame-strip branch in `serializeAsClipboardJSON` is dead code** - Location: `clipboard.ts:150`, `:176-185` - Cause: `elementsMap` holds only the copied elements. `getContainingFrame` therefore returns a frame only if that frame was copied, so the condition is never true. - Effect: a dangling `frameId` ships in the payload. The in-app paste path masks it, because `bindElementsToFramesAfterDuplication` nulls it at `packages/element/src/frame.ts:68`. Host `onPaste` handlers and external consumers still receive it. - Fix: test `element.frameId` against the set of copied frame ids. **12. `getFiles()` type guard returns every file as an image** - Location: `clipboard.ts:436-442` - Cause: the guard returns every `kind === "file"` item typed as an image file. - Effect: a pasted `.excalidraw`, `.excalidrawlib`, PDF or similar file gives an "unsupported file type" error. A non-image file also blocks the mixed-content branch (`App.tsx:4613`) while `data.text` is undefined. - Fix: filter with `isSupportedImageFileType`. Route scene and library files to the loader, as the drop handler does. **13. `parseHTMLTree` filtering is loose and fetches are unbounded** - Location: `clipboard.ts:213-231`, `packages/excalidraw/data/blob.ts:428` - Cause: `startsWith("http")` accepts non-HTTP schemes, and `data:` images are dropped.
